📝 Mayor's Blog Update (Published: October 4, 2026)

On Sunday, October 4, I attended the award ceremony for the fishing tournament held at Arima Valley Scenic Fishing Grounds and Naguri Genki Plaza.

As part of youth development and local revitalization initiatives, I believe fishing in this rich natural setting provided an excellent opportunity for parents and children to communicate with one another.

I hope that in the future, visitors will continue to enjoy a variety of experiences in the Naguri area and throughout Hanno City.
